---
title: "Merge pull request"
description: "Merges a pull request from a workflow."
---

`merge-pull-request.yml` merges the given pull request with a merge
commit. In the [release chain](release.qmd) it merges the `dev` → `main`
PR once R CMD check has passed.

## Example

It is used as a job inside the release trigger:

```yaml
  on-success:
    needs: check
    if: needs.check.result == 'success'
    uses: FlorianSchw/package-workflows/.github/workflows/merge-pull-request.yml@main
    with:
      pr_number: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
```

The full caller is on the [release chain](release.qmd) page.

{{< wf-inputs merge-pull-request.yml >}}

## Permissions

{{< wf-permissions merge-pull-request.yml >}}

The merge only succeeds if your `main` ruleset allows merge commits and all
required checks have passed — see [Branch protection](branch-protection.qmd).
